U00L.name: 北斗之鼠

Re-derived by tools/w3x-import/resolve_unit_tints.py; see out/GoDieEX22s-src/UNIT_TINTS.json entry U00L (channelSource = w3u:Umal(original) x3, baseChain = [U00L, Umal]).
